title: The Moth Lantern
text: A lantern hangs from a branch over the path, swarmed by moths the size of hands, so many the light is hard to see. Their wings are furred and grey, their tongues long. They are drinking its light, and the light is going out.

options.label: Beat the moths off the lantern before its light goes out for good.

outcomes.text: Its warm light lasts the night, keeping the dark well back.

options.label: The sharpest catches moths for their dust, carefully.

outcomes.text: They fill a pouch with shining dust, still faintly warm.
The dust gets in their eyes. The world swims as the moths circle closer.

options.label: Snuff the lantern out and let the moths starve.

outcomes.text: In the dark the moths turn to you. They are still hungry.
